items.summary: The Nuclear Regulatory Commission has finalized a rule impacting the role of the agency’s independent Advisory Committee on Reactor Safeguards.The direct final rule streamlines the ACRS’s role in reviews, focusing its work solely on safety-significant issues that are considered novel or noteworthy.
